costs.intro: A BMW X6 xDrive50i engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X6 xDrive50i engine rebuild starts from £4,500. Other X6 engine variants start from £2,800 (6-cylinder diesel) to £3,200 (6-cylinder petrol), with the current M60i V8 estimated from £6,500. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
